resources.string: Start with a book that genuinely sparks your curiosity. You don\'t have to choose a bestseller or a classic — the best book to begin with is one you actually want to read.
Find a comfortable spot where you can relax with a book. A favorite chair, a soft blanket, and good lighting can turn a few quiet minutes into a little ritual you look forward to.
You don\'t need an entire free evening to enjoy a book. Set aside just ten minutes today and let yourself get absorbed in the story without worrying about how many pages you finish.
Notifications can pull you out of a story just as you begin to enjoy it. Put your phone aside for a little while and give yourself the chance to become fully immersed in what you\'re reading.
When a sentence makes you pause, write it down or mark the page. Over time, you\'ll build a personal collection of ideas, feelings, and words worth returning to.
